correctness.rationale: Under u=|x|/a, inner states map by t(1−u), and outer by the increasing P(u)=s(u−1). Four successive outer states would require P³(u)>1 for some u≤t, whereas P³(t)=ρ<1. Hence the product in every regular four-window is at least Λ=ts³. The proposed u*=ρ/(1+Λ) is strictly inside (0,1); P³(t(1−u*))=u*>0 implies the three outer inputs are all >1 by working backward, and they are all <t because the first is <t and P strictly reduces a positive outer input. The magnitude orbit has one inner state per four and least period four. Precisely one sign reversal in four steps gives least signed period eight. For μ(B)=0, invariance removes the union of all forward boundary encounters (the union of the preimages of B), and expectation of each four-window gives inner mass ≥1/4. Equality makes the integer window count identically one almost surely and subtracting adjacent counts forces the repeated IOOO word up to shift. On that cylinder the four-step magnitude return is ρ−Λu; any displacement from its fixed point grows by Λ on each return and cannot stay in [0,t]. The lift is a single signed eight-cycle and invariance forces equal atom weights. This proves uniqueness of the minimizing measure, not uniqueness of all initial points with a limiting exponent equal to the floor. The rational sample cycle, all images and its multiplier 4096/625 were independently checked with `python3 /workspace/checks/exact_checks.py`; this is not the universal proof.
